desc: Read input N, M, K and edges.
Construct the auxiliary graph for the check function:
Create a source S and sink T.
Create a node for each of the M original edges.

For each original edge $e_i = (u, v)$, create a directed edge in the auxiliary graph from node $i$ to node $j$ if edge $j$ starts at $v$ (i.e., $j = (v, w)$). This represents traversing $e_i$ then $e_j$.
Add edges from S to all nodes $i$ where $e_i$ starts at vertex 1.
Add edges from all nodes $i$ where $e_i$ ends at vertex N to T.
All edges in this auxiliary graph have capacity 1.
Implement a Max Flow algorithm (Dinic's or Edmonds-Karp).
Calculate Max Flow in the auxiliary graph.
